reasons: Card gives no F01-F28 or R01-R19 values, only red-flag counts by area, so the reasons below cite the area counts instead.
Internal control and audit 1 of 4: one item present (could be a material weakness, an adverse ICFR opinion, an auditor change or a disagreement). This raises concern, but it is a single item.

Financial pressure 2 of 4: two pressure signals (for example a capital raise or incentive pay tied to revenue/EPS, or possibly a going-concern or covenant issue). These increase the motive to manage earnings.
Numeric warning signals 1 of 3 computable: one model-based or accrual/cash-flow warning is present. This is a moderate signal on its own.
Transaction complexity 1 of 8: low complexity exposure.
Prior-period corrections 0 of 3, investigations and litigation 0 of 3, and management turnover 0 of 2: no restatements, investigations or executive turnover. This lowers the risk.
Overall: 5 flags spread across 4 areas, with no corrections, investigations or turnover. This is a moderate rather than high risk.
